protocol.name: local dense RoMa cost maps with shared pose refinement
protocol.dataset: 2012-02-18 validation development set; not an independent sequence test
protocol.baseline: SC2-PCR followed by two-stage full-pool refinement at thresholds 1.2 m and 0.6 m
protocol.correspondence_set: frozen train-map RoMa v2 controlled validation cache; shared by peak and score-map paths
protocol.visual_map: cosine similarity of frozen RoMa precise stride-4 refiner features; local 25x25 pixel grid centered at baseline projection; no per-point LiDAR score
protocol.peak_control: one maximum per map, local quadratic curvature as the coordinate precision, then shared-pose reprojection optimization
protocol.scoremap_method: sum of per-map relative negative-log costs (maximum similarity minus sampled similarity) plus one LiDAR-derived 6D pose prior
protocol.lidar_prior: one covariance from the final 0.6 m full-pool Tukey evidence; no duplicate pixel-wise LiDAR prior
protocol.geometry_control: same 6D optimizer and LiDAR prior with visual factors disabled
